faculty.name: Edward H Adelson
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception, including mid-level visual processing and the perception of materials, using image statistics and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知，包括中级视觉处理和材料感知，使用图像统计和计算方法。

faculty.name: Polina Anikeeva
faculty.summary: Develops optoelectronic and magnetic devices to study and treat brain disorders such as depression and Parkinson’s disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计和制造光电子和磁性设备，以研究和治疗抑郁症、帕金森病等神经系统疾病。

faculty.name: Mark Bear
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain is modified by experience, deprivation, and disease, focusing on synaptic plasticity in the visual cortex and hippocampus.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究经验、剥夺和疾病如何改变大脑，重点关注视觉皮层和海马体的突触可塑性。

faculty.name: Edward Stuart Boyden
faculty.summary: Develops tools for analyzing and repairing the brain, including optogenetics and expansion microscopy.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发分析和修复大脑的工具，包括光遗传学和扩展显微镜。

faculty.name: Emery N Brown
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods and signal-processing algorithms to analyze neural data, focusing on understanding general anesthesia and circadian rhythms.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发统计方法和信号处理算法来分析神经数据，重点理解全身麻醉和昼夜节律。

faculty.name: Gloria Choi
faculty.summary: Studies how sensory stimuli drive behavioral responses and internal states, focusing on olfactory circuits and learning mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉刺激如何驱动行为反应和内部状态，重点关注嗅觉回路和学习机制。

faculty.name: Kwanghun Chung
faculty.summary: Develops and applies novel technologies for 3D imaging and phenotyping of biological systems to study brain function and dysfunction.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和应用新型技术进行生物系统的三维成像和表型分析，以研究大脑的功能和功能障碍。

faculty.name: Robert Desimone
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain selectively amplifies relevant information and suppresses distractions through synchronized neuronal activity, particularly in the prefrontal cortex.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过同步神经活动选择性地放大相关信息并抑制干扰，特别是在前额叶皮层。

faculty.name: James DiCarlo
faculty.summary: Studies the neuronal mechanisms of visual object recognition using neurophysiology, fMRI, and computational modeling in awake, behaving non-human primates.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉物体识别的神经机制，使用清醒行为非人灵长类动物的神经生理学、功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Sven Dorkenwald
faculty.summary: Develops computational tools to map and analyze synapse-resolution connectomes, investigating how neuronal circuits are organized in the brain.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发计算工具来绘制和分析神经元连接组，研究神经回路的组织方式及其如何支持复杂的计算。

faculty.name: Linlin Fan
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的认知和神经机制，使用计算模型和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Evelina Fedorenko
faculty.summary: Studies how people understand and produce language using behavioral and brain imaging methods in healthy adults and patients, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何理解和产生语言，使用行为和脑成像方法在健康成人和患者中以及计算建模。

faculty.name: Michale S Fee
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of complex sequence generation and learning in songbirds, focusing on circuitry in RA and HVC.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鸟类歌声序列生成和学习的神经机制，重点关注RA和HVC回路。

faculty.name: Guoping Feng
faculty.summary: Studies molecular mechanisms regulating neuron-neuron communications and synaptic function, using genetic models to understand autism, OCD, depression and schizophrenia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元间通讯和突触功能的分子机制，使用遗传模型来理解自闭症、强迫症、抑郁症和精神分裂症。

faculty.name: Ila Fiete
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of memory, integration, and learning in the brain and deep networks using computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑和深度网络中的记忆、整合和学习机制，使用计算建模技术。

faculty.name: Steven Flavell
faculty.summary: Studies how neuromodulators like serotonin control long-lasting behavioral states in nematodes, using genetics, optogenetics, and calcium imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经递质如血清素如何控制动物长时间的行为状态，使用遗传学、光遗传学和钙成像技术。

faculty.name: John D. E. Gabrieli
faculty.summary: Studies neurodevelopmental and mental health differences using MRI and EEG, focusing on brain-behavior relations across the lifespan.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育和心理健康差异，使用MRI和EEG，关注生命各阶段的大脑-行为关系。

faculty.name: Edward A Gibson
faculty.summary: Studies the syntax of human languages and how people process and learn language using behavioral experiments and statistical modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类语言的句法以及人们如何学习和处理语言，使用行为实验和统计建模方法。

faculty.name: Ann M. Graybiel
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of the basal ganglia in learning and memory, focusing on habits and their relation to cognition, emotion, and disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基底节在学习和记忆中的机制，重点关注习惯与认知、情绪和疾病的关系。

faculty.name: Mark Harnett
faculty.summary: Studies how biophysical features of neurons enable complex computations in neural circuits, using electrophysiology and imaging in behaving animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元的生物物理特征如何使神经回路能够执行复杂的计算，使用电生理学和成像技术在行为动物中进行研究。

faculty.name: Susan Hockfield
faculty.summary: Studies molecular substrates of mammalian brain development, focusing on aggrecan and BEHAB/brevican proteins.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物大脑发育的分子机制，重点在于aggrecan和BEHAB/brevican蛋白。

faculty.name: Alan Pradip Jasanoff
faculty.summary: Develops next-generation brain imaging techniques to study neural mechanisms of behavior and cognition in live animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发下一代脑成像技术，研究行为和认知的神经机制在活体动物中的表现。

faculty.name: Mehrdad Jazayeri
faculty.summary: Teaches quantitative methods and computational models in neuroscience, helping students analyze and model neurobiological data.
faculty.summary_zh: 教授神经科学中的定量方法和计算模型，帮助学生分析和建模神经生物学数据。

faculty.name: Nancy Kanwisher
faculty.summary: Studies the functional organization of the brain, focusing on specific regions involved in visual perception, social cognition, and intuitive physics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑的功能组织，重点关注涉及视觉感知、社会认知和直观物理的具体脑区。

faculty.name: Roger Levy
faculty.summary: Studies how linguistic communication resolves uncertainty, using computational modeling and psycholinguistic experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言交流如何解决不确定性，使用计算建模和心理语言学实验。

faculty.name: Troy Littleton
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of synaptic formation and function using Drosophila genetics and electrophysiology, with implications for neurological diseases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究突触形成和功能的机制，使用果蝇遗传学和电生理学方法，对神经退行性疾病具有重要意义。

faculty.name: Josh McDermott
faculty.summary: Studies how people hear, focusing on sound recognition, cocktail party problem, and music perception using behavioral experiments and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类听觉，包括声音识别、鸡尾酒会问题和音乐感知，使用行为实验和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Earl K Miller
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of working memory, attention, and executive control using multiple-electrode neurophysiology and computational techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆、注意力和执行控制的神经机制，采用多电极神经生理学和计算方法。

faculty.name: Elly Nedivi
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular genetic analysis of synaptic plasticity, focusing on activity-regulated genes and their roles in neuronal and synaptic function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究突触可塑性的分子遗传分析，重点关注活动调节基因及其在神经元和突触功能中的作用。

faculty.name: Tomaso A Poggio
faculty.summary: Studies the computational basis of intelligence, including learning, memory, and visual understanding, using mathematical theories and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究智能的计算基础，包括学习、记忆和视觉理解，使用数学理论和计算模型。

faculty.name: Drazen Prelec
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making processes, including self-control and consumer behavior, using behavioral and fMRI methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程，包括自我控制和消费者行为，使用行为和fMRI方法。

faculty.name: Sara Prescott
faculty.summary: Studies memory and learning processes, using techniques from cognitive neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习过程，使用认知神经科学的技术。

faculty.name: Alexander Rakhlin
faculty.summary: Studies machine learning and statistics, focusing on online prediction, deep learning, and high-dimensional statistics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究机器学习和统计学，专注于在线预测、深度学习和高维统计。

faculty.name: Robert Mark Richardson
faculty.summary: Studies brain electrophysiology and behavior in patients undergoing functional neurosurgery, focusing on basal ganglia-cortical dynamics and closed-loop brain stimulation for epilepsy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究功能性神经外科手术中的人类大脑电生理和行为，重点是基底节-皮层动态和癫痫的闭环脑刺激。

faculty.name: Rebecca R Saxe
faculty.summary: Studies the development and neural basis of social cognition, focusing on how people think about others and make moral judgments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知的发展和神经基础，关注人们如何思考他人以及进行道德判断。

faculty.name: Laura E Schulz
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn concepts and causal relations, using computational models and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习概念和因果关系，使用计算模型和婴儿注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Nidhi Seethapathi
faculty.summary: Studies the computational objectives governing movement decisions, the strategies used to execute movement, and how new movements are learned.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动决策背后的计算目标、执行运动所使用的策略以及如何学习新运动。

faculty.name: Morgan Hwa-Tze Sheng
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cell biology of synapses and synaptic plasticity, and the pathogenic mechanisms of neurodegenerative and psychiatric disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究突触和突触可塑性的分子和细胞生物学，以及神经退行性疾病和精神障碍的致病机制。

faculty.name: Pawan Sinha
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain recognizes objects through visual experience, using experimental and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉经验如何使大脑识别物体，采用实验和计算方法。

faculty.name: Mriganka Sur
faculty.summary: Studies the development, plasticity, and dynamics of cerebral cortex circuits using experimental and theoretical approaches, identifying mechanisms of brain disorders and proposing novel therapeutics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层回路的发育、可塑性和动态变化，通过实验和理论方法识别大脑疾病的机制并提出新型治疗方法。

faculty.name: Joshua B Tenenbaum
faculty.summary: Studies the computational basis of human learning and inference, using behavioral testing, mathematical modeling, and formal tools like Bayesian statistics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类学习和推理的计算基础，使用行为测试、数学建模和贝叶斯统计等正式工具。

faculty.name: Fan Wang
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of general anesthesia, pain perception, and movement control, discovering new pathways and circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究全身麻醉、疼痛感知和运动控制的神经机制，发现新的通路和电路。

faculty.name: Brandon Weissbourd
faculty.summary: Studies the transcriptional shifts across cell types in jellyfish, using single-cell RNA-seq and genetic models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究水母细胞类型中的转录变化，使用单细胞RNA测序和遗传模型。

faculty.name: Matthew A Wilson
faculty.summary: Studies how memories form and persist, focusing on neural activity in the hippocampus and neocortex during waking and sleep.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆的形成和持久性，重点关注海马和新皮层在清醒和睡眠期间的神经活动。

faculty.name: Feng Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算模型和神经影像技术研究学习和记忆的神经机制。
